subject: GGIR release 2.3-3 now available on GitHub (test volunteers welcome)

messages.author: 017566be30afa7f3
messages.subject: GGIR release 2.3-3 now available on GitHub (test volunteers welcome)
parts:
Dear all,

GGIR release 2.3-3 is now available on GitHub. This is a beta-release in preparation  for the new 2.4-0 release for CRAN scheduled for early June.

If you want to help find bugs or typos before they end up in the 2.4-0 CRAN release then that would be great. Please send me your bug reports or the typos found in the documentation before the 29th of May. Ideally via https://github.com/wadpac/GGIR/issues but if you do not have a GitHub account an e-mail is also ok.

You can install version 2.3-3 with:
library("remotes")
remotes::install_github("wadpac/GGIR", ref="2.3-3")

When you run GGIR part 5 please use argument:
frag.metrics = "all",
part5_agg2_60seconds= TRUE,

This will activate the fragmentation analysis and will make sure that epoch level information is aggregated to 1 minute epochs, required for the fragmentation analysis.

The vignette (not online yet) will have a new paragraph documenting the fragmentation analysis. At the moment you can check it out here: https://github.com/wadpac/GGIR/blob/master/vignettes/GGIR.Rmd

Updates since the last GGIR release on CRAN (2.3-0 in February 2021):
- Part 5 fragmentation analysis added (see instructions above)
- Part 5 report, added argument week_weekend_aggregate.part5
- Part 5 intensity gradient now also extracted here for waking hours
- Part 5 LUX variables added (beta-implementation as this is work in progress and may even change before CRAN release)
- Part 2 and 5, Bout detection algorithm improved, bout.metric 6 is now the default.
- Parts 1, 2, 3 and 5: Added argument maxNcores to control maximum number of cores to be used in parallel processing mode
- Part 1 fixed bug related with ENMOa calculation which made the metashort data frame to be empty.
- Part 2 fixed bug to report generation in part 2.
- Fixed bug related to visualization report when a file has not been processed in part 4
- Part 1 when using ad-hoc data format: now able to handle timestamp column.
- Part 2 report when using ad-hoc data format with header: now able to extract
  and store serial number in part2 report.
- Test file generation for unit tests improved. Thanks Lena Kushleyeva.
- Part 2 estimation of longitudinal axis and related error handling improved
- Part 3 bug fixed in usage of argument dayborder when not 0. Thanks Ruben Brondeel for spotting this.
- Part 3 bug fixed in recognition fraction night invalid for first night. Thanks Ruben Brondeel for spotting.
- Part 1 fixed warning related to closing connection to bin files. Thanks John Muschelli.
- Part 2 fixed warning that deprecated IVIS argument does not exist

Best,
